name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.isCutB_iff
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Valid g)
  (b : List.{0} Nat),
  Iff
    (Eq.{1}
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.isCutB g
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.canonIds (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)) b)
      Bool.true)
    (DisequalityDispersion.IsCut (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.termCut g hv b)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.outputs g hv))

source.code:
theorem isCutB_iff : g.isCutB g.base.canonIds b = true ↔ IsCut (g.termCut hv b) (g.outputs hv) := by
  unfold isCutB IsCut
  rw [g.outputs_eq hv]
  simp only [List.all_eq_true, List.forall_mem_map, Bool.not_eq_eq_eq_not, Bool.not_true]
  constructor
  · intro h j hj ha
    have := h j hj
    rw [← g.avoidsDP_iff hv b j (g.outNodes_lt hv j hj)] at ha
    rw [ha] at this
    exact absurd this (by decide)
  · intro h j hj
    have := h j hj
    rw [← g.avoidsDP_iff hv b j (g.outNodes_lt hv j hj)] at this
    simpa using this
